pricing.details: Free (Basic) 0 €/month — 10 AI credits lifetime, 1 hour of media to AI chat lifetime, export up to 720p, 1 export file, 2 GB cloud storage; no card to sign up. Essentials 19.99 €/month, or 143.90 €/year (11.99 €/month billed yearly) — 450 AI credits/month, unlimited media to AI chat, export up to Full HD, unlimited exports, 20 GB storage. Pro (most popular) 39.99 €/month, or 287.90 €/year (23.99 €/month billed yearly) — 1,200 AI credits/month, export up to 4K, 120 GB storage. Teams 84.99 €/creator/month, or 599.90 €/creator/year — 3,000 AI credits/month, 1 TB storage, team workspace. Business: custom (contact sales). Yearly plans are officially presented as 40% off versus monthly; credits on a yearly plan are added each month, not all at once, and unused monthly credits do not roll over. Official FAQ: 7-day refund on new subscriptions, excluding used AI credits. One-time top-up packs: 300 credits 10.99 €, 600 credits 19.99 €, 900 credits 29.99 €, 1,800 credits 44.99 €, 3,000 credits 74.99 €. Recurring credit add-ons also exist. These are official euro prices from the payment API that fills the pricing page for this region.
